title: Playboy: Karaoke Collection Volume 2
native_title: プレイボーイ・カラオケ ＶＯＬ２
overview: Playboy Karaoke Collection Volume 2 (プレイボーイカラオケvol.2) is a 1996 compilation of karaoke music videos with Playboy models in the background released by VIC Tokai for the Sega Saturn exclusively in Japan. A first volume was also made.
